title: California power: CAISO supply observations
methodology: CAISO Today's Outlook fuel-source observations are five-minute average megawatts for the CAISO balancing authority, not all California electricity use.

The main series is the most recent verified complete prior day found within the configured lookback. latest is a separately dated current-feed snapshot, not a prediction or a continuous live connection.
Every number comes from the source CSV. Missing values remain null; no interpolation, clipping, smoothing, or estimated observations are added.

All signed source values are preserved, including negative solar, imports, and battery values. Negative batteries indicate net charging; positive batteries indicate net discharging. Negative imports indicate net exports.

hydro combines Small hydro and Large Hydro. other combines Geothermal, Biomass, Biogas, Coal, and CAISO's Other column. These original components remain available in each row. Any missing component makes its aggregate null.
total_mw is the algebraic sum of all eight displayed buckets, including signed imports and storage. It is not a separate demand measurement.

Hybrid-resource components are already included by CAISO in their respective fuel types and are not added again. Renewable and carbon-free are different concepts; neither share is inferred by this dataset.
Times use America/Los_Angeles. Expected intervals account for daylight saving transitions. Future slots in a partial day are reported separately from gaps within its observed period.
CAISO describes Today's Outlook data as informational, subject to change, and unsuitable for billing or operational planning. It identifies OASIS as its official market-data source.
